Hi, I'm Margot.

I share simple, friendly money habits for women starting over after divorce. No jargon, no shame, no lectures. Just a kind place to begin.

Here's what you'll find here:
• 3 numbers to start
• 1 hour to set up
• 20 minutes a month to keep it clear

Zero is a starting line. Follow along, and tell me below: what's the first thing you want to get clear on?

General education, not financial advice.

I made you something, and it's free.

The Three Numbers Starter Sheet is one page. Three numbers:
• What's coming in
• What goes out
• How many months you could keep going

That's all you need on day one of starting over. No budget, no app, no plan yet. Grab a pencil and give it about 20 minutes. Ugly numbers are allowed.

Link in my bio. Enter your email and it's yours.
